scope: one campaign of real block-0 weights with synthetic activations; paired online operator paths

timing_contract.primary: synchronized host wall; warmed alternating-order repetitions; counts recorded separately
timing_contract.supplemental_gpu: command-buffer duration; not individual shader attribution
timing_contract.included: online activation packing/rotation, projection/gate, next AdaLN/INT8 packing; native layout and padding
timing_contract.excluded: loading, offline weight preparation, prior pipeline compile/warmup, correctness readback and CPU residual restore
timing_contract.dispatches: three per path: activation packing, GEMM and next AdaLN/packing; residual restore occurs before timing
